title: Collatz Conjecture (JavaScript)
prompt:
In this project directory, implement a Node.js CommonJS module named collatz_conjecture.js exporting one function via module.exports = { steps }:
  - steps(n) : returns the number of steps needed to reach 1 using the Collatz sequence rules (if n is even, next = n / 2; if n is odd, next = 3*n + 1), starting from n. steps(1) is 0. Throw an Error for any n < 1 (zero or negative).
There is already a hidden reference test suite at tests/test_collatz_conjecture.test.js (uses Node's built-in node:test + node:assert, no npm install needed) -- do NOT modify it. Your Testing phase should run `node --test tests/*.test.js` from the project root (in addition to any tests you write yourself) and every test must pass. Also add a short README.md explaining the function.
